channel.title: kvp projects — updates
channel.description: New versions of kvp projects apps for Mac and Windows.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.4.3
item.description:
Changed

  • “Today” is shorter: the date with arrows instead of the row of days, the week inside the dark card (tap a day to open it). Done tasks and “Someday” are folded into two chips under the input.
  • The current tab at the bottom stands out more: a green pill and a bold name.
  • Shopping: a new item is added with “Done” on the keyboard and goes to the end of the list, starting with a capital letter. Quick-add tasks start with a capital letter too.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.4.2
item.description:
Added

  • Levels for stars: Beginner → Helper → Master → Hero → Legend. A level grows with all stars ever earned, spending doesn’t lower it; you see how many are left to the next one.
  • “Saving for…”: tap 🎯 by a reward in “My stars” — “Today” shows a bar of how many stars are still needed.
  • Badges: “A week in a row”, “Family helper”, “Dream came true” and more — a collection in “My stars”. A new level or badge is met with a “Hooray!”.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.7.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • A long group name in “Words” no longer breaks the word letter by letter: the group is now a quiet line under the word.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.4.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Version 0.4.0 closed right at launch. It opens as usual now.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.7.0
item.description:
Changed

  • “Words” has a fresh look: you see at once how many words are new, in progress and known, and the tiles with the numbers filter the list. Words sit in a compact list, “Learn” no longer covers them, and tapping a word opens its card with everything you can do with it.
  • “What to learn” is clearer: “All mixed” and the groups are tiles with icons, and the screen remembers your last choice.
  • “Day plan” has a fresh look: each block is its own card, all games are visible at once, and the topic is picked from a list. Tap a number to type any value, not only the buttons’ steps.

Fixed

  • Russian word counts read right again («2 слова») — since the last version they showed «2 Слова:».

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.4.0
item.description:
Changed

  • “Week” and “Calendar” are one tab now, “Plan”: “Week · Month · Day” at the top. How to mark the circles — under the “?”.
  • Tab titles are more compact — more fits on the screen.
  • Statistics show series and records: each habit’s current series and its best.
  • Long habit names no longer get cut on “Week”, and you can go forward to plan the next week.
  • “Today” shows tasks first, habits under them. No shared “Add” button: type a task right in “Task for today”, add a habit with “+ Habit” by the “Habits” heading.

Fixed

  • The keyboard no longer covers the field you type in: a day’s note, a wish, a quick task at the bottom of the list.

Added

  • A home-screen widget, “Habits for today”: the day’s tasks and habits, tap a line to mark it. Add it by holding an empty spot of the home screen → “Widgets”.
  • Ready habits: “Water”, “Morning exercise”, “Reading”, “No sweets” and more, in one tap on the new habit screen.
  • A checklist in a task: “Pack for the trip” — passport, charger, tickets. The task shows how many are ticked.
  • The family’s shopping list on “Family”: add — everyone sees it, bought — tick it, and bought items go away the next day.
  • Duties in turn: in a family task pick “In turn” — each time it goes to the next person, like “Take out the trash”.
  • Birthdays: hold a person’s circle in “Family” → “Birthday”. A week before, “Today” reminds you, with a link to their wish list.
  • The week’s summary: on Sunday and Monday “Today” shows how the week went, the best habit, the longest series, the tasks done.
  • Rename the family: the pencil at the top of “Family” (adults only).
  • Hold a person’s circle in “Family” for “Rename” and “Make an adult” / “Make a child”. Anyone can change their own name.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.9
item.description:
Changed

  • The day’s plan on “Today” is more compact: its blocks are steps in a row that fill as you go, and “Next” opens the lesson’s next step straight away.
  • Sections on “Today” are now tiles of their own, each icon on a coloured square.
  • The bottom menu no longer disappears in the catalog, lists, topics and settings, so you can go to another section from there. It hides only while you read a book, learn words, play or talk.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.3.1
item.description:
Changed

  • Inviting to the family is a QR now: “Family” → “Invite” → a name → a QR. A child or a partner needs no mail and no password — point their phone’s camera, and they are in.
  • A child’s new phone or tablet: hold their circle in “Family” → “Connect one more phone”.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.3.0
item.description:
Added

  • Family — a tab of its own: create a family, invite adults and children with a 6-digit code. Settings — the gear on “Today”.
  • Family tasks: a task’s “For” — yourself, someone of the family or everyone; “anyone” or “each”. It is on their “Today”, everyone sees who did it.
  • Stars: an adult gives habits and tasks stars, they come by themselves for what is done (a week in a row — a bonus), or by hand.
  • Rewards for stars: an adult sets a reward for a child (“30 minutes of cartoons — 20 ⭐”), the child takes it when there are enough. The balance is on “Today”.
  • Wish lists: your own wishes with a link, a price and an occasion; on someone else’s — “I’ll give it”, hidden from the list’s owner.

Fixed

  • An adult’s “Today” no longer can show a child’s habits.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.8
item.description:
Changed

  • The first tab is now “Today”: the day’s plan, what to repeat, “Continue” — the book and the conversation where you stopped, and every section as tiles at the end. Recording is a card there and its own “Speech” section.
  • Five places at the bottom: “Today”, three sections of your choice and “More”. By default “Words”, “Reading” and “Conversation”; change them in “Bottom menu” at the end of “Today” or in “More”. If you often open another section, the app offers once to put it at the bottom.
  • “Who translates” now has two clear options — “Phone” and “AI”. A book’s ready-made breakdown is shown above them and is always used; the chosen one translates what isn’t prepared yet.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.2.2
item.description:
Added

  • Length — “No length” or your own (“Other…”: hours and minutes) for tasks and habits, in the “Plan” menu too. Picking a time no longer sets 30 minutes by itself.
  • A habit’s “Calendar” setting: “Don’t show”, “In the app” or “In the app and Google”. Water or teeth can leave the calendar — they stay on “Today” and in “Week”.
  • While an update downloads, the window keeps showing what is new, with a new wavy progress line and the percent.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.2.1
item.description:
Changed

  • “Someday”: each task has a “Plan” button — pick a day, then a time and how long, all in one small menu.
  • On “Today” a task has a calendar icon — move it to another day and time just as fast.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.2.0
item.description:
Added

  • Tasks: a “Tasks” block under the habits on “Today”. The box marks done, a tap opens, a long press — “Tomorrow”, “Someday”, “Skip this time”.
  • Quick task: type at the bottom of the block and press Enter — it is on today at once.
  • Not done — a task moves to the next day by itself, marked “moved”.
  • Repeating tasks (“Pay the rent on the 1st”): the next time appears when you mark this one, counted by the schedule or from the day you did it.
  • “Someday” — tasks with no day: a link under “Tasks”, one tap puts one on today or tomorrow.
  • A task has a time, a length, reminders with a “Done” button, a colour, a note and an event in Google Calendar.
  • The “Add” button asks: a habit or a task.
  • Tasks show in “Week” (done / all per day), in the calendar and in statistics.
  • Family: a parent can give a child a chore — it appears on the child’s “Today”, and the parent sees whether it is done.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.1.4
item.description:
Added

  • “Habit settings” in the menu a long press opens — on “Today”, in “Week” and in a habit’s calendar.

Changed

  • “Back” on any tab first returns to “Today”, and only there closes the app.
  • The app remembers the view you chose: “Month”, “Week” or “Day” in the calendar and the period in statistics.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.7
item.description:
Changed

  • The bottom of a book is now one thin line: the translation’s state, the progress bar and the settings icon. All of a book’s settings — who translates, translation under the text, turning pages, the font — are in one sheet.

Fixed

  • The translation under sentences no longer shows twice when the AI takes several short sentences as one.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.6
item.description:
Added

  • The catalog shows which books already have a ready-made breakdown for your language and how much (“Breakdown: the beginning”), and the “With breakdown” sticker leaves only those. Inside such a book, “Who translates” shows “Ready-made breakdown”.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.5
item.description:
Added

  • Two buttons at the bottom of a book: “Who translates” and “Translation under the text”. Each option says what it gives and what it costs, and what can’t be turned on for this book is grey with the reason.
  • New “On tap” mode: the text stays clean, and tapping a word shows the whole sentence’s translation at once.
  • Translation under paragraphs and sentences now works when reading page by page too.
  • A line above the progress bar says what’s happening with the translation: “Ready-made breakdown · free” or “Preparing the translation of this place…”.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.4
item.description:
Added

  • A translation can now stand under each sentence: reading settings → “Translation under the text” → “Under each sentence”. Free: the phone translates, or the book’s own translation is used.
  • Catalog books come already prepared if someone prepared them before: tap a word to see its dictionary form, expressions and the sentence’s translation, with no subscription spent and even with no AI.
  • In the word panel of books the phone translates — “Break down the sentence”: the AI explains a whole sentence in one short request.

Changed

  • New books are translated by the phone by default; the AI is turned on by choice. “Ask the AI” is now called “What it means here”.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.3
item.description:
Added

  • Stories in the catalog have pictures and a level, with a level picker on top. Each page of a story has its picture too.
  • Books in the catalog have covers and an approximate length in pages; the “Children’s and easy” sticker leaves only easy books.
  • A story or book you already added is marked “in library” and opens instead of being added twice. Catalog books show their covers in the library.

Fixed

  • Books in the catalog load again: the list now comes from our server, and a book is downloaded from Gutenberg’s mirror when its site is down.
  • When learning English, stories without a Russian translation no longer say “translation: English” — they honestly say “no translation”.
  • For languages with no stories, the catalog says so instead of “The source isn’t answering”.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.2
item.description:
Changed

  • In “Learn”, new words no longer come in a row: they are woven in one by one among the ones already started.
  • A new word’s card shows once: after “Don’t know” the word goes on to be learned instead of coming back as the same card.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.1
item.description:
Added

  • Lesson by plan: “Start lesson” on the plan card, and the app leads you — finish the exercises and “Next: Reading” appears at the bottom, then games, talk, a recording. Leave whenever you like.
  • The day plan can name a book to read (or “the last opened”) and one or two games: in the lesson they open by themselves, one after another.

Changed

  • “Translation under paragraph” now sits right under its paragraph and is paler: it is clear what it belongs to, and it stays out of the text’s way.
  • In the day plan, Reading has a clearer hint: all the text read counts, not only new words.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.6.0
item.description:
Added

  • Day plan: build your own lesson for every day — how many exercises on your words, how many words to read, minutes to play and to talk with the partner, how many recordings. The Speech tab shows what's done; tap a row to go there. Ready plans: “Light”, “Words only”, “Full”.
  • Topics now gather everything: add books from Reading to a topic, and its page has “Learn”, “Play” and “Talk” — all on its words. A topic can also be chosen for the whole day plan.
  • A topic can be created without the AI, by its name alone: its words come from its books.
  • Talk on a topic: the partner keeps to it and brings in its words.

Changed

  • “Words by topic” is now “Topics”; it's in “More” too, and works without the AI.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.5.0
item.description:
Added

  • A book of your own with each paragraph followed by its translation is recognized: the translation leaves the text and shows with its paragraph, no AI needed.
  • The new book screen has a “Translation” block: it shows whether the text already has a translation, and lets you pick who translates — the AI (with a rough number of requests) or the phone’s translator (free).
  • At the bottom of a book: “Translation: AI / phone / from the book” — tap to change.
  • Reading settings have “Translation under each paragraph”: small and pale under every paragraph, taken from the book or the phone’s translator, no AI spent.
  • A catalog in Reading: stories with a ready translation (Global Storybooks) and free Project Gutenberg books — no files to download by hand. One tap and it's in the library, open.
  • Catalog books are translated by the phone, no AI spent; “Ask the AI” is there for a single word. Stories come with every page already translated. The book’s menu has “Source” (authors and license) and an “AI translation ahead” switch.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.4.0
item.description:
Added

  • A new task, “Card”: you see the word, tap Show translation, and answer “I know” or “I don’t know”. A new word starts with it on the first day. “I don’t know” isn’t a mistake: the word comes back later.
  • Study on the main screen first asks what to study: all words mixed or the groups you tick.

Fixed

  • In page-by-page reading the page number at the bottom no longer sticks at the first page, and the book stays at the same place after the pages are laid out again.
  • When you dictate a long answer, the screen scrolls along with the text: its end and the buttons under it no longer go below the bottom edge.

Changed

  • Words added while reading go to a group named after the book: pick it in “What to study” and in the Words filter. Turn it off — More → Settings → Study → “Words from a book go to its group”.
  • The order of tasks: Card → Choice of four → Build from letters → Type → Say.
  • A word left halfway starts again from the easiest task next time in Study; what it scored isn’t lost.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.1.3
item.description:
Added

  • Plans for “N times a week” habits: in “Week” tap a day — “Done” or “Plan” (at a time or not). A planned time shows on “Today”, reminds you, can lock the screen and goes to Google Calendar.
  • “Plan your week”: a card in “Week” and a notification on the day you choose (Settings → Weekly plans), with a “Like last week” button.
  • A missed plan on “Today” offers to move it: to today, to tomorrow, or drop it. Done on another day — it counts, and the plan closes by itself.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.1.2
item.description:
Added

  • “Several times a day” habits with reminders: a circle with a ring of portions and the next one’s time (“2/8 · 12:00”). Hold the circle to see every time and mark any of them.
  • A reminder knows how many are done: “6 of 8 glasses”, and if you drank ahead, the extra one doesn’t come. A “+1” button right in the notification.
  • “A reminder for each time”: one button spreads reminders evenly from the morning to 22:00.
  • The “Show each time separately” setting: every time is a circle of its own at its own time, handy for medicine.
  • In the “Day” calendar each time is a mark at its own hour.

Changed

  • “Today” shows only what’s planned for today; the rest is behind an “N more not for today” line. What you do beyond the plan stays in the list marked “beyond the plan” and counts separately.
  • “Week”: a tap marks the day whole — all eight of “8 glasses” at once; a day not done in full shows a ring in its circle instead of looking missed. Hold the circle to mark each time by the clock.
  • “Today” is more compact: the “List / Circles” switch is an icon at the top right, the progress card is slimmer.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.3.3
item.description:
Fixed

  • Signed in with a subscription, the AI works right away: no need to switch from “Own key” to “kvp Service”. If you’ve pasted your own key, it’s used.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.1.1
item.description:
Added

  • “Today” as circles: all of the day’s habits in a grid by morning, afternoon and evening — tap a circle and the habit is done; for “8 glasses” each tap adds one. Switch “List / Circles” above the habits.
  • The “Week” tab: each habit in a row with seven circles for the days — mark a forgotten day with one tap without opening the habit.

Fixed

  • An empty progress ring no longer shows a dot, and names in “Left” are written as they are.
  • The app’s version shows once in Settings.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.3.2
item.description:
Fixed

  • In “Say the word”, Write and Don’t remember now sit side by side as stickers instead of scattered over the screen.
  • Writing instead of saying gives an ordinary keyboard, with word suggestions and its own microphone.
  • In “Type the word”, Don’t remember and Hint no longer hide under the keyboard, and the hint shows right in the card.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.3.1
item.description:
Changed

  • In Study, after a mistake “Fix” and “That was right” are now visible sticker buttons, and “Finish” is an oval button with a flag.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.3.0
item.description:
Added

  • A new task in Study — “Build from letters”: the word’s letters shuffled, tap them in order. It comes right after the choice of four, so you see how the word is spelled first. It’s switched on and off with the other tasks.
  • “Type the word” has a Hint: the first letter and places for the rest. An answer with a hint isn’t counted, but it isn’t a mistake either.
  • “Type the word” shows the example sentence with a gap where the word goes.

Changed

  • Every step in Study now opens with the choice of four, then typing and saying, so each step takes one more task.
  • A one-letter typo (or two swapped letters) in a longer word counts: you’ll see the right spelling.
  • Another form of the word or a close word is marked “almost” by the AI: not counted and not a mistake, the word comes back.
  • On a mistake the wrong letters in the right word are underlined.
  • Without the AI, Study says so up front, with a Connect button.

Fixed

  • When you write the answer instead of saying it, the keyboard’s own microphone works again.

item.title: Привычки (Android) 0.1.0
item.description:
Added

  • Habits on any schedule: every day, on weekdays (also every other week), every few days, on days of the month, a number of times a week or a month.
  • "Don't do" habits (say, no sugar): every day without a slip counts by itself, you mark only the slips.
  • Several times a day with a label: "8 glasses of water", "20 pages".
  • A start time and a duration: the habit takes its own block in the calendar — an hour, 15 minutes or whatever it needs.
  • Several reminders per habit, like in Google Calendar: 10 minutes before, an hour before, at the start or at a time of your own. Mark "Done" or snooze for 10 minutes right from the notification.
  • Marks for today and past days, a note for the day, a skip for a good reason that doesn't break the streak.
  • Pause a habit for a holiday or illness: paused days don't count as missed.
  • Streaks, the best streak, habit strength and the share done over 30 days.
  • Calendar: month, week and an hour-by-hour day, together with your Google Calendar events.
  • Habits in Google Calendar: choose a calendar in Settings and habits become repeating events.
  • Statistics: how many times each habit was done this week, month, year and all time.
  • A screen lock at the habit's time: a full-screen window, like an alarm clock, opened by a task — translate foreign words, solve sums, type your own phrase, shake the phone or mark the habit. There is always an emergency exit.
  • Your own word list for the task and a starter set of Spanish words.
  • Family: a parent sees a child's habits and results and can add habits for them.
  • kvp account: sign in with a code from an email. Habits sync between your devices.
  • Export all marks to a spreadsheet (CSV).
  • Check for and install updates right in the app: Settings → Updates.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.2.0
item.description:
Changed

  • A new look for the whole app: warm “paper” by day and a dark screen at night, one pink accent, its own headline font. Bright colors and a slant only at the moment of an answer in Study: the card turns green or red, with a “right!” or “oops!” sticker.
  • The tabs are now Speech, Words, Conversation and More. The main screen is one big “Say something” button, then today’s review and a feed of what grew out of your speech.
  • More replaces Profile: it shows at once whether the AI and the cloud work; Reading, Games, Say a phrase, Translator, the recordings archive and Settings are there too.
  • Conversation is a tab of its own: start one, the history, what the partner remembers about you.
  • The Words tab’s filters are in one row: “Words and phrases ▾”, the topic group and the level.

Removed

  • The Calm / Bright / Comic look choice: the app has one look now.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.19
item.description:
Changed

  • Comic: once answered, the whole screen turns green for a right answer and pinkish red for a mistake; the “RIGHT!” burst is green too. “Don’t remember”, “Finish”, “Fix the text” and “That was right” are comic buttons now instead of underlined text.

Fixed

  • The answer field in Study is no longer taken for a password field: password managers don’t offer to save the answer, and the keyboard still suggests no words.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.18
item.description:
Added

  • New “Comic” look (Profile → Look): Study is drawn as a comic — each task has its own color, stickers on the card, a “RIGHT!” burst for a correct answer. Other screens look calm for now.
  • Study has a “Finish” button at the bottom: stop any time, every answer is kept.
  • In Study, “Type the word” and “Say the word” tasks have a “Don’t remember” button: it shows the right answer at once and counts as a mistake.

Changed

  • Study: in “Type the word” the keyboard opens at once, its Done key checks the answer, and keyboard suggestions no longer give the word away. A right answer and a mistake each get a short buzz.
  • Voice answers: “Done” is now “Check”, and what you said is checked at once, without an extra step. To fix the text by hand, tap it while speaking.
  • Trail: the castle guard asks one task, not five. Right — the treasure is yours; wrong — a step back, as on any cell, and roll to the castle again.

Fixed

  • Cloud recognition no longer turns a question in the middle of a phrase into “,?”: a single question mark stays.

item.title: Dictum (Android) 0.2.0
item.description:
Added

  • A conversation no longer splits a thought at pauses: when the other person pauses mid-sentence, the pieces are joined into one phrase within half a second and translated again as a whole, so the meaning is kept. Needs the internet and an AI (Dictum Cloud or your own key).

Fixed

  • Dictum no longer closes right after you sign in: with Dictum Cloud the app used to go away a couple of seconds after every launch.
  • “Recognize again” works with Dictum Cloud: with the cloud on, the button used to ask for an OpenAI key.
  • If Dictum Cloud doesn’t connect at the start of a conversation, Dictum says so and tries again; once it connects, the cloud recognizes the recording from its very start. In the “Automatic” mode, speech in another language used to go unrecognized.

item.title: Dictum 0.10.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Изменено

  • В Истории у записи с аудио появился проигрыватель: пауза, продолжение с того же места, перемотка и время. Пока запись играет, это видно и в свёрнутой строке.

Исправлено

  • Прослушивание в Истории больше не накладывается само на себя: новая запись останавливает прежнюю, а при начале диктовки звук ставится на паузу.
  • Если во время диктовки зажать её клавишу и случайно нажать другую, запись больше не пропадает бесследно: она продолжается, а отменить её можно клавишей Esc.

item.title: Dictum 0.9.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Изменено

  • Текст после оформления меньше похож на написанный нейросетью: вместо длинного тире «—» обычный дефис « - », после «Ну» и «Ну вот» в начале фразы нет запятой, а в Dictum Cloud одна мысль больше не дробится точками на короткие предложения.

Исправлено

  • Первая диктовка после сна Mac снова идёт через Dictum Cloud: раньше она распознавалась встроенной моделью Apple с сообщением «Dictum Cloud не сработала».

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.17
item.description:
Added

  • A new game in Games, Trail: a board game on an island. Roll the die and walk the path through the beach, forest, swamp and mountains to the castle with the treasure. Every cell has a task with your words: pick the translation, recognise the word by ear or put it together from letters. Right — a star; wrong — a step back. A bridge carries you over the river, a trap throws you further back, and a guard waits at the castle. The game is saved; the record is the fewest rolls.
  • Translator: a Translator tile on Home, also opened by long-pressing the app icon. Type or say a phrase in your native or learned language, and the direction switches by itself. You get the translation read aloud, other ways to say it (more polite, casual) and the phrase's words in their dictionary form. Add the phrase or any word to the dictionary with one tap. Without the AI, the phone's translator gives the translation alone.
  • Words for a topic: in the Dictionary, describe a topic, such as “at the doctor's, stomach ache”, and the AI picks words and set phrases for it at your level. Tick the ones you need: they go to the dictionary as that topic's group, and you can learn them right away. Don't like the pick? Tap More. Topics are kept.
  • The Dictionary can show one topic's group: the list and Learn cover only it.

Changed

  • The Text button is gone from Home: to read your own text, paste it in the Reading tab.

item.title: Волейбол (Android) 0.3.2
item.description:
Added

  • "Sign in with a password" on the sign-in screen, for kvp accounts that have one. The usual sign-in is still a code from an e-mail.

Fixed

  • Stats fit a narrow phone: the period switch on one line, the "errors" heading in full.
  • A player's error count on the score screen carries the same bolt as the "Error" button, on any phone.

item.title: Волейбол (Android) 0.3.1
item.description:
Added

  • Delete your account: "Account" → "Delete account". The app asks first and says what goes.

Changed

  • The watch app now installs over the previous one and is ready for Google Play, where it will update itself.

item.title: Волейбол (Android) 0.3.0
item.description:
Added

  • A Wear OS watch app: the score of the match the phone keeps and two big buttons — a point to team one or two, no players to pick. The watch talks to the phone over Bluetooth. How to install — "Account" → "Wear OS watch".

item.title: Волейбол (Android) 0.2.0
item.description:
Added

  • Put an error on a particular player: tap "Error" under their team and pick who erred, or hold the player → "Error". Errors show in the stats.
  • Hold any player on the score screen → "Serves now": the serve goes to them and the turn goes on from them.
  • A player can have a photo, even one who never signs in: "Players" → tap the player → "Take" or "From gallery".
  • Change your own name in "Account" → "My name": it changes in all your companies.

Changed

  • Holding a player on the score screen opens a menu (serve, error, take a point back) instead of taking the point back at once.

item.title: Волейбол (Android) 0.1.2
item.description:
Changed

  • On the score screen "Team" and "Error" sit right under the team's last player; upright, both teams keep close to the score.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.16
item.description:
Changed

  • Reading no longer translates the whole text at once: it prepares the page you are on and the next two, and moves ahead as you turn pages. Flicking quickly through pages starts nothing, so a long book doesn’t cost more than you read. The translation follows on from the text before it, so names and terms stay the same from page to page.

Added

  • Race lets you choose the speed before the start: Calm, Normal or Fast. The choice is kept, and each speed has its own record.

item.title: Волейбол (Android) 0.1.1
item.description:
Added

  • Keep the score with the phone upright: one team on top by the left edge, the other below by the right one, the score in the middle. Turn the phone and the screen follows.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.15
item.description:
Changed

  • Blaster’s Calm and Normal speeds are noticeably slower.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.14
item.description:
Changed

  • Blaster is now one living field: after a hit the other asteroids are thrown up, bounce off the walls and each other and fall again, and a new word flies in. Any word on the field may be asked next.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.13
item.description:
Changed

  • Reading: the text's title is now in the top row, beside the back arrow — more room for the text.

Fixed

  • «Blaster»: long words wrap inside their plate and no longer spill past the asteroid.
  • «Blaster»: the game no longer freezes for a second after a shot — the beam and the blast come at once, as they should. In «Race» the road no longer stops after a gate either.
  • The games show words in their dictionary form, as «Learn» does: words kept in a text's form are brought to it when «Games» opens.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.12
item.description:
Added

  • «Learn»: the tasks can be chosen — «Choice», «Type», «Say» (the icon on top). The choice is kept.
  • «Learn the text's words» starts with a warm-up: every word of the text once by choice, not counted, then the usual tasks.
  • «Blaster»: the speed is chosen before the game — «Calm», «Normal», «Fast», each with its own record.

Changed

  • Words added in the form they had in a text are brought to the dictionary form: «stealing» → «steal — воровать». The example stays.
  • «Blaster»: the translation is on top now, and a shot no longer stutters.
  • Reading by pages: the turn is drawn with more care — soft shadows along the slanted fold, a rounder bend, no hard bands. An up-and-down move no longer turns the page by accident.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.11
item.description:
Added

  • Reading: «Learn the text's words» on top — learning just the words and phrases added from this text. A word now remembers which text it came from.

Changed

  • «Blaster» looks much better: space with flying stars and a nebula, rocky asteroids with craters, a ship with an engine flame, a glowing laser, explosions of debris and sparks, a shake on a hit and a miss.
  • Reading by pages: turning is more lifelike — the fold runs at a slant, as if the page were taken by its lower corner, with softer shadows.

Fixed

  • Reading: a dictionary word is highlighted in the text in any form — «stealing» and «stole» when the dictionary has «steal».
  • Reading: a translation already prepared is there at once when a text opens, not gathered again.
  • Reading by pages: a page no longer scrolls up and down — its height is the real room on the screen, and the translation's line moved to the bottom bar.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.10
item.description:
Added

  • Word card: a word already in the dictionary can be removed right from the card — «Remove from dictionary».
  • Word card: it shows where the translation comes from — the AI, in context, or the phone, word for word.

Changed

  • Every noun, verb, adjective and adverb now shows its dictionary form with a translation: «went» → «go — идти», «bottom» → «bottom — дно». It shows at once, even while the text's translation is being prepared, and in the word card in a conversation and a recording's review too. Texts already opened are prepared anew.
  • Reading by pages: a page bends like paper as it turns — the curve of the fold, the back of the sheet and its shadow on the next page. Both ways.

Fixed

  • Reading by pages: the page is no longer dimmed — the next page was drawn over the current one.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.9
item.description:
Changed

  • «Learn», the «Choice» task: the wrong options now resemble the right one — the same part of speech, and on later steps the same topic. Throwing out the plainly different no longer gives the answer away.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.9.1
item.description:
Changed

  • A new recording in an open note goes to the very end of its text, not where the cursor was.

Fixed

  • “Transcribe again” no longer says the recording can’t be read, and the sound’s wave shows the real recording.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.8
item.description:
Added

  • Reading: the translation shows on the text itself — paragraphs not yet translated are paler with a soft light running over them, and ready ones turn clear.
  • Reading page by page: «Turn» in the reading settings — «Down» or «By pages». Pages turn left and right like paper, the page number is in the bottom right corner, and the place is kept.

Changed

  • Add buttons are «To dictionary» everywhere — for a word and a phrase alike.

Fixed

  • Reading: the dictionary's phrases are highlighted in the text, like words.
  • Reading: the translation no longer gets stuck on «Couldn't translate parts»: the app sends no more requests than the service takes, and retries by itself after a slip.
  • «Blaster»: the asteroids with words fall from the top again.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.7
item.description:
Added

  • Two arcade word games: «Blaster» — shoot the asteroid with the right word before it reaches the ship, and «Race» — switch to the lane with the right word. Three lives, points for a streak, faster with each wave.
  • Reading: a word shows its dictionary form with its translation — «went» → «go — идти», «fuimos» → «ir — идти». That form goes to the dictionary, the example stays from the text.

Changed

  • Words and phrases are now in one «Dictionary»: the «Phrases» tab is gone, with «All / Words / Phrases» on top. One «Learn» button and one repetition ladder for everything; long phrases aren't typed letter by letter — they are picked and said. Phrases keep their progress.
  • «Pairs» and «True or false» now include phrases.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.6
item.description:
Changed

  • The «Text» tile on Home: a pasted text or subtitles can be opened with «Read» — with translation, roles and expressions, as in «Reading». «Take apart into phrases» works as before.

Fixed

  • Reading: a short text's translation is ready much sooner, and the place you read comes first, so a tapped word shows its translation at once. The top shows how much is ready and whether you can read yet, and «Try again» if a part failed. Stage directions like «[music]» go, and two lines of dialogue on one line by dashes are split.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.9.0
item.description:
Changed

  • A voice recording in a note is now a compact player with the sound’s wave and its length, and the dictated text sits under it, marked by a thin line at its left; the arrow by the player folds and unfolds the text. Edit the text and it becomes ordinary note text, the recording stays. The recording’s “⋯” menu: “Transcribe again” (with the Note Calc Cloud plan), “Detach the text”, open the file, remove the recording — its text stays, and the file is kept next to your notes.
  • With the Note Calc Cloud plan dictation works as in Dictum: while you speak the cloud’s text with punctuation shows at once, and after “Done” it lands in the note almost instantly.
  • “Inbox” is now called “Quick notes”, the field above the list — “Add to Quick notes…”.
  • Sync and cloud dictation now come with the Note Calc Cloud plan: speech is recognized accurately and the text set out at once — punctuation, paragraphs, lists, numbers as digits. Without the plan notes live on the phone and the phone recognizes speech itself. What’s on — Settings → Account; the «Neural network / Built-in» choice is gone.

Fixed

  • Neural dictation works again: before, the phone’s own text without punctuation was put in instead.

item.title: Волейбол (Android) 0.1.0
item.description:
Added

  • The app offers to update itself when a new version is out on the site; you can also check by hand: Account → Version.
  • Its own icon: a volleyball.
  • "Finish" on the score screen: the match ends at the current score — the side ahead in sets, then in points of the set, wins; a tie is a draw. Changed your mind — "Continue the match".
  • "Lineups" on the score screen: replace a player who left, swap people or teams, fix who serves if the serve went wrong.
  • Who serves first is chosen on the score screen before the first point.
  • Sign in to a kvp account with a code from an email: groups, matches and stats are kept on the server and shared with everyone in the group.
  • Invites: an admin gives a code, a friend joins the group and picks themselves from the players — their past points and matches become theirs.
  • Roles in a group: creator, admins and members.
  • A match scored on another phone is shown live; if the scorer's phone died, press "Score here".
  • Works without the internet; changes go to the server when the connection is back.
  • The end of a set shows its score with "Undo the last point"; the end of a match shows the winner and the sets.

Changed

  • The format of a match is "Beach" or "Indoor"; changing a rule keeps the kind.
  • Team names on the score screen are bigger, on a badge of the team's colour.
  • New match: "remove" sends a player to rest; long-press and drag a player to the other team or to rest; tap a resting player to pick the team.
  • The screen never turns by itself: sides are swapped with the ⇄ button; a reminder can be turned on in the format settings.
  • "Error" is pressed under the team that made the mistake: the point goes to the other team.

Fixed

  • Someone removed from a group can no longer come straight back with an old code; an admin can cancel all codes.
  • A player's own code works once; a code typed on the Russian keyboard or pasted with the whole message is understood.
  • "Back" after joining a group leads to the list of groups.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.5
item.description:
Added

  • Word games on Home: «Pairs» — match words and translations against the clock, «True or false» — a one-minute speed round, «Build the word» — put the letters in order. Words come from your dictionary, the ones you are still learning first.
  • Reading: you can paste or open subtitles (SRT, VTT). Times and numbers go, lines are joined into sentences, speakers' names stand out — you read by roles.
  • A short text, such as an episode's subtitles, is translated in full when you open it: the bottom shows how much is ready.

Changed

  • Reading: tap a word that is part of a set expression and the whole expression is selected and translated. The word on its own is a line below, and you can add it to the dictionary too.
  • Conversation: the correction style now works the same in any situation, not only in a lesson with a teacher. The correction comes at the start of the partner's reply, so it isn't lost.

Fixed

  • Your mistakes are no longer corrected by recognition: a spoken answer in «Say the phrase» and a turn in a conversation by «Text» are written down word for word, as you said them.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.4
item.description:
Added

  • With the subscription, recordings and spoken answers are recognized in the cloud: more accurately, with punctuation, and your mistakes stay as said. No subscription or network — the phone recognizes them, as before.
  • Conversation: «How it hears you» in the settings before a talk. «Text» — the cloud recognizes your speech, you see your words as you speak, and the partner gets exactly them. With the subscription, for testing for now.

item.title: Dictum 0.8.4
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Исправлено

  • Просьбы к нейросети больше не превращаются в обещания: если распознавание услышало «проанализирую» вместо «проанализируй», оформление исправит это по смыслу — а «я проанализирую» и «завтра посмотрю» оставит как есть. Работает в Dictum Cloud, «Оформленном» и «Чистом тексте».

item.title: Dictum 0.8.3
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Исправлено

  • Dictum Cloud больше не отключается, если диктуешь очень много: раньше после нескольких сотен диктовок за сутки распознавание уходило на встроенную модель Apple.

item.title: Dictum 0.8.2
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Исправлено

  • Dictum Cloud сразу подхватывается, когда появляется интернет: если Mac включился раньше сети, уже первая диктовка проверяет облако и, если оно на месте, распознаётся и оформляется им — а не встроенной моделью Apple без оформления.

item.title: Dictum 0.8.1
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Исправлено

  • В первой настройке список моделей на шаге «Режим» прокручивается: раньше нижние модели не помещались в окно.
  • Первые слова на плашке больше не появляются, пропадают и появляются снова: с Dictum Cloud и Soniox плашка сразу показывает их текст, без черновика встроенного распознавания.

item.title: Note Calc 0.6.0
item.description:
Added

  • Note Calc Cloud: notes sync between devices (sign in with a code from an email; images and files don't sync yet) and cloud dictation — the text comes with punctuation, paragraphs and lists. Without the plan, notes stay on this Mac and the Mac itself recognizes speech. What's included — Settings → Account.
  • Voice notes: “+” → “Voice note”, or the round microphone button at the bottom of an open note. The text appears right away, and the recording stays in the note and plays inline.
  • Tables with formulas inside any note (=A1*2, SUM, totals) — the “Table” button above the note. Separate table notes are gone: old ones open as a note with that table.
  • Pin mode — the 📌 button: the window becomes a narrow strip at the side of the screen, above other apps; press again to put it back. Settings → General → “Pinning”.
  • Tags and archive instead of statuses: tags have their own colors, badges above the list filter notes, “Archive” takes a note out of the list. Old statuses became tags.
  • Easier writing: a formatting bar above the text, a small bar next to selected text, a “/” menu for headings, lists and tables, blocks dragged by ⋮⋮.

Changed

  • A new window look: the note with its tabs is a rounded card, the notes list is simpler (Inbox and pinned notes as tiles, notes grouped by day, account at the bottom). A line's result sits right after it; the “Total” line and the results column are gone — select lines to see their sum and average at the bottom.

Fixed

  • Cloud dictation works as in Dictum: while you speak the window shows the cloud’s text with punctuation, and after «Done» the finished text goes into the note almost at once (it used to take 5–8 seconds). The recording is still kept in the note.
  • Very fast typing no longer loses text, the notes window no longer jumps to another desktop, and the note is lighter than the list again.

item.title: Dictum 0.8.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Добавлено

  • Dictum Cloud — распознавание и оформление по подписке, без ключей и выбора моделей: войди в аккаунт и выбери «Dictum Cloud» в Настройки → Общие → «Как работает Dictum». Там же режимы «Свои ключи» и «Офлайн» — один выбор вместо трёх страниц настроек.
  • Сценарий «Оформленный текст»: диктовка сразу выходит с абзацами и списками, без оговорок и слов-паразитов. Длинная диктовка оформляется, пока ты говоришь, — текст готов через полсекунды после остановки.
  • Диктовки подряд понимают друг друга: если следующая продолжает тему (в течение трёх минут), имена, названия и мысль не рвутся на части.
  • Лишние точки на паузах убираются, знаки расставляются заново по смыслу, а вопросительный знак переезжает в конец вопроса.
  • Новые модели по твоему ключу: Soniox — распознавание за долю секунды и словарь до 800 слов, Cerebras — оформление за треть секунды.

Изменено

  • Словарь стал спокойнее: слева список по группам с поиском, справа карточка слова; слово перетаскивается в другую группу, по списку можно ходить стрелками.

Исправлено

  • Длинная диктовка больше не теряет слова в конце, а в начале не появляются слова, «услышанные» в фоновом шуме. Смена сценария во время записи меняет и оформление. Dictum Cloud не выключается, если на секунду пропала сеть, и понятно говорит, если подписки нет.

item.title: Shotlark 0.17.0
item.description:
Added

  • Area recording remembers the last frame: next time it shows right away, with handles on its corners and the rest dimmed. Record it as it is, move it, resize it, or draw a new one beside it.
  • Choose the look: Settings → General → “Appearance” — warm light, grey glass like macOS itself, or warm dark. Settings, the editor and the screen recording panel get the new warm look.
  • The cursor shows what you can do: a hand over a mark you can drag, arrows on resize handles, crosshairs on the ends of arrows and lines.
  • Drag a text by the edge of its frame, even while typing. With the Text tool, dragging moves the text and a plain click opens it for editing.

Changed

  • In the window after a recording, the video no longer fills the whole window: it has rounded corners and room around it, on black.
  • The countdown before a recording shows in the middle of the recorded area, not of the screen. The Stop button on the recording bar is black, so it no longer looks disabled.
  • Ask for the file name (Settings → Screenshots) now works for Save in the editor too: the first save of a screenshot asks for the folder and the file name.
  • Long text on a screenshot wraps at the right edge of the image instead of stretching the canvas.
  • Settings are split into tabs; the main choice in “Screenshots” and “Recording” is shown as big cards, the annotation style as sample pictures. If you rearranged the editor's tools, their order has been reset — set it up again.
  • The pencil style looks livelier and the same on every mark: sharp corners, slightly curved sides, circles drawn with an overlap, smooth lines and arrows; the step counter's tail is smooth and pointed.

item.title: Cliplark 0.6.0
item.description:
Added

  • Component licenses: which third-party parts are inside and on what terms (Settings → About).
  • An important announcement from the developer (a bad release, say) is now hard to miss: shown once, without taking focus or interrupting a recording.

item.title: Textum 0.6.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Добавлено

  • Лицензии компонентов: какие чужие программы внутри и на каких условиях (Настройки → О программе).
  • Важное объявление от разработчика (например, о неудачной версии) показывается заметно: один раз, не забирая фокус и не посреди записи.
  • Если другая программа не отпускает клавиатуру (там осталось открытым поле пароля), а ты уже работаешь в другом месте, Textum через пару секунд покажет, какая это программа, и кнопкой «Перейти» откроет окно с этим полем. Та же кнопка — в меню Textum и в Настройках → Раскладка.
  • Сниппет срабатывает, даже если его ключевое слово набрано не в той раскладке: «;fly» на английской сработает как «;адр». Короткие ключевые слова из одних букв (например, «ок») — по-прежнему только как записаны, чтобы не путаться с обычными словами.

item.title: Dictum (Android) 0.1.5
item.description:
Added

  • Dictum Cloud by subscription: recognition and formatting with no keys of your own and no models to pick. Sign in in Settings and turn on “Recognition and formatting with Dictum Cloud”; the minutes used this month show there too. Offline, the phone recognizes by itself.
  • The “Formatted text” scenario: a dictation comes out with paragraphs and lists where you listed things, without slips of the tongue and filler words. Needs an AI model (Models → Text); Groq is the fastest.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.8.5
item.description:
Changed

  • A more compact notes list: the Inbox is a slim strip with an «Add to Inbox…» field, «Notes» sits in one row with the icons, and note rows are lower and the same height with tags or without.

Fixed

  • The number pad button works even when no keyboard is open: it puts the cursor in the note and brings up the digits. It’s now a round button of its own, left of the formatting bar.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.8.4
item.description:
Added

  • Tags and an archive instead of statuses: a long press gives the note’s tags and «Archive». Tags are coloured (the same colour as on the Mac) and show in the note’s row and as chips over the list (a tap shows only the notes with it); the archive is a row at the end of the list. Former statuses became tags of the same names.
  • Tables with formulas right inside an ordinary note: the table button on the formatting bar, the size with a tap on a square. The table looks like an ordinary one; column letters and the formula bar are under the ⊞ button in its top right corner. Cells calculate as in a spreadsheet (=A1*2, SUM, totals), the number pad types into a cell, and Undo undoes table edits too. Rows and columns — with a long press on a cell (insert above, below, left, right).

Changed

  • There are no separate table notes any more: a table goes into any note. «New table» is gone from «+» and from the app icon’s shortcuts.
  • A line’s result always follows it right away; the results column on the right is gone. The «Results in notes» setting is gone.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.8.3
item.description:
Changed

  • A new look: calm colours of its own with blue instead of the wallpaper’s, thin icons, a blue «New» button. Above the list — an «All» chip next to the groups; a note with nothing to count shows «—» on the right.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.8.2
item.description:
Added

  • Choose who recognizes speech: Settings → General → «Speech recognition» — «Neural network» or «Built-in».

Fixed

  • If the neural network couldn’t recognize a recording, the bottom of the screen says why (for example, you need to sign in) instead of silently keeping text without punctuation.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.8.1
item.description:
Added

  • Speech is recognized by a neural network: accurate text with punctuation. It needs you signed in (Settings → Account) and online; otherwise the phone’s own recognition, now with punctuation too.
  • A recording can be removed from the note with the × beside it.
  • Long-press the Note Calc icon: «New note», «New table», «Voice note» — straight into it.

Changed

  • The «Dictate» button is now round, in the note’s bottom left corner, instead of on the bar above the keyboard.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.8.0
item.description:
Added

  • Dictate into the open note: the microphone button on the bar above the keyboard. The text and the recording go in at the cursor — a note can hold any number of recordings.
  • Voice notes: «+» → «Voice note». Speak and the text appears right away; the recording stays in the note and can be played back.
  • Note statuses: In progress, Waiting, Done — long-press a note. A coloured label shows in the list.
  • A new notes list: each note shows its total, the inbox is a card with «Add a line…», groups are chips at the top, notes go by day. Swipe right to pin, left to delete.

item.title: Shotlark 0.16.0
item.description:
Added

  • Shotlark now runs on macOS 15 Sequoia too. Before macOS 26 panels come without Liquid Glass, and only Claude (with your key) names screenshots: Apple Intelligence needs macOS 26 for that.
  • Component licenses: which third-party parts are inside and on what terms (Settings → About).
  • An important announcement from the developer (a bad release, say) is now hard to miss: shown once, without taking focus or interrupting a recording.

Fixed

  • While recording with a USB microphone (wired EarPods, say), its level now shows right. The microphone icon used to turn red as if it were silent, though the sound was recorded.
  • Resize a pinned screenshot by dragging any edge or corner, as a window, smaller than it was taken too, its proportions kept.
  • Auto-scroll in a scrolling capture waits for the page to stop before taking it: fewer gaps and repeats on sites that scroll smoothly.

item.title: Dictum (Android) 0.1.4
item.description:
Added

  • Updates from inside the app: Settings → Updates; a new version downloads and installs by itself and never interrupts a recording.
  • A kvp account: sign in with an email code or Google; sign out or delete the account in Settings. It arrives together with sync.
  • One record button: choose a mode (Voice memo, Conversation or Dictation) and press; recording starts at once. Change the mode while recording: the sound goes on, and what has been said shows in the new mode right away, in a conversation the earlier phrases get translated.
  • After recording: what to do with it after Stop in each mode (notes, a meeting summary, clean text to the clipboard), also in Processings → Default.
  • Settings → Storage: recordings' sound deletes itself after 7, 30 or 90 days; the text and results stay.
  • Automatic language in a conversation, with cloud recognition or offline when both languages are downloaded (Android 14+).
  • A look in the Material 3 Expressive style: colors from your wallpaper, a large title that shrinks as you scroll, rounded rows, buttons that change shape when pressed.
  • Conversations with live translation, voice memos and dictation with processing, recordings with search and playback, processings, your own keys for cloud recognition and AI, downloads for working offline, launching from the home screen, quick settings and Google Assistant.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.3
item.description:
Changed

  • In a conversation, your turn's bubble shows only while the microphone listens, with your words as you say them. When you answer by the button, it tells you to tap the microphone. The text field is behind the keyboard icon.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.7.0
item.description:
Added

  • Syncing notes with Note Calc on the Mac and other devices (beta): Settings → Account, sign in with a code from an email. Pictures and files don’t sync yet.

item.title: Note Calc (Android) 0.6.0
item.description:
Added

  • The first version for Android: calculator notes with the same calculations, tables and formatting as on the Mac.
  • A number pad for calculations: the button with digits on the bar above the keyboard, «ABC» brings the usual keyboard back.
  • Updates right in the app: when a new version is out, Note Calc offers to install it. To check by hand — Settings → Updates.

item.title: Dictum 0.7.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Добавлено

  • Синхронизация Dictum Cloud с iPhone и Android: обработки, сценарии и словарь, История — по переключателю. Вход по коду из письма: Общие → «Синхронизация (бета)».
  • Лицензии компонентов: какие чужие программы внутри и на каких условиях (Настройки → О программе).
  • Важное объявление от разработчика (например, о неудачной версии) показывается заметно: один раз, не забирая фокус и не посреди записи.

Исправлено

  • Растянутые звуки через дефис («э-э», «м-м-м», «а-а») убираются целиком: раньше от «э-э» в тексте оставался лишний дефис.
  • Если скачивание модели оборвалось из-за медленного или пропавшего интернета, Dictum так и пишет и подсказывает нажать «Скачать» ещё раз — вместо непонятной системной ошибки.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.2
item.description:
Added

  • Sign-in with Google works: Profile → Cloud → «Continue with Google».
  • You can now sign in with another account on this phone: the app asks first, and the phone's data goes to the new account. A pasted key stays.

Fixed

  • The check whether the phone recognizes a language no longer hangs for good when the system doesn't answer: the spoken answer becomes available again.
  • When Google refuses an address, the message says so and offers signing in by a code from an email.
  • When the answer to deleting an account is lost, the app says the result is unknown instead of «the cloud isn't answering».
  • Conversation on a bad connection: a line said just before a drop no longer disappears or doubles, and the talk no longer ends because renewing the minutes took a moment.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.1
item.description:
Added

  • Sign in with Google next to the email code (Profile → Cloud). It appears once it is set up.
  • Your subscription key arrives by itself: sign in with the email the subscription is on, nothing to paste. The key field stays for a different email.
  • Deleting the account: Profile → Cloud → Delete account. Data on the phone stays, a paid subscription isn't cancelled.

item.title: LanguageApp (Android) 0.1.0
item.description:
Added

  • Record a conversation or paste a text: it splits into sentences with a translation under each, on the phone itself, without internet; more accurate with an AI key.
  • Phrases and vocabulary with levels, search and spaced repetition: tap a word in a text to add it, and the app decides what to ask and when.
  • Words are led through steps, from today to a check in a month. How many right answers it takes: Profile → Study → Effort.
  • «Say the phrase»: see a phrase in your language and say it in the one you're learning, your own phrases or new ones from the AI on a topic and level you choose.
  • Voice conversation with a partner: situations, your level, corrections along the way, a memory of you (you can erase it) and a review at the end. By your own Gemini key or the kvp service, whose minutes go in pieces of 3.
  • A bad connection or a phone call doesn't end a conversation: nothing said is lost, and no minutes are spent during a call.
  • Reading: books and any texts (EPUB, FB2, TXT), tap a word for its translation and add it to your lists; your place in the book is kept.
  • Cloud by subscription: sign in with a code from an email and your words, phrases, texts, conversations and books reach your other phone. Audio and keys stay on the phone (Profile → Cloud).
  • Updates inside the app: once a day it looks for a new version and installs it when you press the button (Profile → Updates).
  • Two looks: calm and bright (Profile → Look → Style).

item.title: Shotlark (Windows) 0.2.0
item.description:
Added

  • The first version for Windows: captures of an area, a window and the screen, scrolling captures, video and GIF recording, the markup editor, a thumbnail after each capture, pinning on top of windows, history and text recognition. Comes with a regular installer; the license is in Settings → About. Updates come by themselves: a check once a day, installed when you press the button.

item.title: Shotlark 0.15.0
item.description:
Added

  • Screenshots are named by what they show: «supabase-email-table-grants 2026-10-25 at 15.04.05» instead of «Screenshot …». Apple Intelligence makes the name on this Mac; without it, Claude with your own Anthropic key (a small copy of the screenshot goes there, a fraction of a cent each). Settings → Screenshots.
  • Scrolling capture of a window: while choosing the area, press Space and pick a window.
  • Open any picture in Shotlark from Finder: «Open With → Shotlark».
  • Opened straight from the disk image or Downloads, Shotlark offers to move itself to Applications, so permissions no longer go to a temporary copy.

Changed

  • Pencil marks now match our other apps: even lines with uneven corners, ovals that overlap where they close, text on a white card in a colored frame.

Fixed

  • Capturing is steadier: a scrolling capture no longer brings other Shotlark windows over the page, a sleeping display no longer breaks a capture, Stop works while a recording starts, and an unfinished recording shows in History at once.
  • Editor and files: «Scale to 1x» and «Flip» no longer delete the capture, a blur never lets the hidden part show, a double Save no longer makes a second file, marks from a newer Shotlark are never saved over, «Check for Updates…» answers plainly — and other small fixes.

item.title: Note Calc 0.5.4
item.description:
Changed

  • A line added with Quick Entry to the open note shows up in the text right away: the note doesn't reload, the cursor and ⌘Z undo stay where they were.

Fixed

  • If a note is changed in another app while it is open in Note Calc, the edits from both places are now merged — before, typing in Note Calc could overwrite the other change.

item.title: Cliplark 0.5.0
item.description:
Added

  • Opened right from the disk image, Cliplark offers to move itself to Applications, restarts from there and ejects the image — otherwise macOS permissions went to a temporary copy and didn't work.
  • Cliplark can uninstall itself, with or without your history; you then drag the app to the Trash (Cliplark menu → «Uninstall Cliplark…»).

Fixed

  • «Check for Updates…» answers plainly: «You’re up to date» — no cryptic build numbers.

item.title: Textum 0.5.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Добавлено

  • Сломанный текст чинится перед отправкой ИИ: абракадабра из PDF, «кракозябры» от неверной кодировки, неверная раскладка, разрывы строк. Исправленное видно в цитате над ответом.
  • Новые виды панели: «Стекло», как у Cliplark (macOS 26 и новее), светлая с мягкой тенью и «карандашом», как плашка Dictum (Настройки → Панель).
  • После вставки сниппета можно сразу изменить его или вернуть набранное слово; закреплённые эмодзи — с булавкой в верхнем ряду, закрепить одним нажатием.
  • Открытый из образа диска или «Загрузок» Textum предлагает перенести себя в «Программы»; удалить его можно из самого приложения (меню Textum → «Удалить Textum…»).

Изменено

  • Окно действий появляется у выделенного текста везде: на веб-страницах, в письмах и чатах, в Claude, Slack и VS Code, а в Codex и ChatGPT — у места последнего щелчка.
  • Окно по сочетанию клавиш открывается быстрее; пока ответа нет, видно, что происходит; Esc после ответа закрывает окно (к списку действий — кнопкой ←).

Исправлено

  • ИИ-действия больше не возвращают текст без изменений, если в нём есть просьбы; переключатель раскладки не принимает сокращения вроде «внж» за слово; сетка эмодзи не дёргается; «Проверить обновления…» отвечает понятно.

item.title: Dictum 0.6.2
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Исправлено

  • Диктовка вставляется в Codex: он не сообщает, где курсор, и раньше Dictum показывал «Курсор не в текстовом поле». Плашка встаёт там, где ты последний раз щёлкнул в его окне, и «Обработать» — там же.
  • Кнопка «Вставить» на панели срабатывает и в приложениях, которые не сообщают о фокусе, и Dictum запоминает: дальше вставляет туда сразу.
  • Живой текст на плашке появляется и на macOS 15 — его даёт прежняя модель Apple прямо на Mac; а где её нет, или основная модель облачная, — любая готовая модель на Mac. Под настройкой написано, почему он идёт с задержкой или почему его нет.

item.title: Dictum 0.6.1
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Изменено

  • Живой текст на плашке есть и без языкового пакета Apple: его даёт основная модель на Mac, с задержкой в пару секунд; под настройкой «Текст во время речи» написано, почему он медленнее или почему его нет.

Исправлено

  • Диктовка вставляется в ChatGPT для Mac: его поле сообщения не отмечено как поле ввода, и раньше Dictum показывал панель «Вставить / Скопировать» вместо вставки.

item.title: Dictum 0.6.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Добавлено

  • Dictum проверяет модели на Mac: после скачивания и после пустого ответа модель распознаёт эталонную запись, и если ошиблась — помечается «Работает неправильно» с кнопкой «Переустановить» (Настройки → Нейросети, там же кнопка «Проверить»).

Исправлено

  • В Chrome диктовка с новой пустой строки начинается с большой буквы и без лишнего пробела — раньше Dictum принимал её за продолжение предыдущей строки.
  • Если открыть Dictum прямо из образа диска, он предложит перенести себя в «Программы», перезапустится оттуда и отключит образ — разрешения не достанутся временной копии.
  • Если после переустановки Универсальный доступ «включён», но не работает, кнопка «Разрешить» сама убирает старую запись в Системных настройках, и macOS заводит новую.
  • Если модель на Mac слышит речь, но возвращает пустой текст (например, после переустановки остались её старые файлы), диктовку распознаёт запасная модель, а плашка подскажет удалить модель и скачать заново.
  • Плашка с ошибкой или результатом больше не обрезается справа и сверху на некоторых Mac.

item.title: Dictum 0.5.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Добавлено

  • Запись встреч и диктофон: твой голос и собеседники из Telegram, WhatsApp, Zoom или Meet, а также длинные записи с микрофона распознаются прямо на Mac; итог, конспект и экспорт — в новом разделе «Записи» (меню Dictum → «Записать встречу» / «Диктофон»).
  • «Обработать» после вставки: у конца текста появляется тонкая кнопка — выбери инструкцию («Письмо», перевод…) или сделай одну основной и обрабатывай в один клик (Настройки → Инструкции).
  • Сценарии и инструкции вместо режимов: у диктовки, встречи и диктофона свои сценарии и клавиши, а инструкции для ИИ — отдельный раздел, их можно перетаскивать и дублировать. Твои режимы перенесены сами.
  • Умная первая буква и умные пробелы: продолжение фразы начинается с маленькой буквы, пробелы между диктовками ставятся сами (Настройки → Общие → Вставка текста).

Изменено

  • ElevenLabs и OpenAI распознают потоком: слова на плашке появляются сразу, а текст вставляется меньше чем за секунду после остановки; ElevenLabs учитывает твой словарь.
  • Плашка записи встаёт у курсора в Chrome, Claude, Slack, VS Code и Telegram и больше не закрывает поле ввода.

Исправлено

  • Надёжнее: после перезагрузки Mac диктовка не ждёт загрузки моделей, Esc и обрыв связи больше не теряют текст, клик мимо поля до диктовки открывает панель «Вставить / Скопировать»; Dictum можно удалить из самого приложения (меню Dictum → «Удалить Dictum…»).

item.title: Note Calc 0.5.3
item.description:
Added

  • «Check for Updates…» in the menu of the Note Calc icon in the menu bar, as in my other apps.

Fixed

  • «Install and Relaunch» in the update window now really installs the new version — it used to answer that the update couldn’t be installed.

item.title: Shotlark 0.14.0
item.description:
Added

  • Scrolling capture works upwards too — handy for chats; the direction is picked by itself.
  • Copy a scrolling capture right away: ⌘C, no Done and no editor.
  • Shotlark can uninstall itself, with or without your capture history (menu → «Uninstall Shotlark…»).

Changed

  • Scrolling capture: dots mark the area's corners, and you can adjust it before you start scrolling; after a click into the page ↩ no longer finishes the capture (finish with Done or ⌘C).

Fixed

  • Scrolling capture stitches more reliably: with fast scrolling, in chats with a blinking caret, and it finds its place again if you scroll too abruptly; the side preview has no stripes, and the button bar stays out of the image.
  • Text recognition no longer stalls for 15–30 seconds the first time after installing or updating.

item.title: Note Calc 0.5.2
item.description:
Fixed

  • The pinned window (📌 «Keep on top») shows on every desktop and over apps in full screen.
  • Switching to Note Calc with ⌘Tab brings back a closed window instead of leaving an empty app.
  • The notes window opens on the desktop you are on instead of taking you to the one where it was left.
  • Turning formatting on with nothing selected and typing nothing no longer leaves invisible marks in the note — even with two styles at once.
  • Headings copied into Google Docs no longer get double spacing.

Changed

  • Links in notes open only when they lead to a web page, mail or a phone number: a link from someone else's text won't start a program on your Mac.
  • The «A» button remembers the last text color after switching notes or restarting.

item.title: Note Calc 0.5.0
item.description:
Changed

  • The formatting bar has a new look, like in Google Docs: buttons sit in rounded groups and show icons instead of letters. Clicking «A» colors the text with the color picked last (shown by the bar under the letter); the arrow next to it opens the palette. Scrolled text fades out under the bar. In a narrow window the bar stays on one line: buttons that do not fit go under «⋯».
  • The interface has no thin dividing lines anymore: the sidebar, tabs, totals bar, settings and input fields are set apart by soft fills and rounded corners.

Added

  • You can remove Note Calc from your Mac right inside the app: Note Calc menu → «Uninstall Note Calc…» or Settings → Help. The app goes to the Trash along with its settings and license (the «Keep my data» checkbox keeps them). Your notes in Documents → Note Calc stay.
  • The formatting bar now has underline (⌘U), text color (the «A» button, seven colors that adapt to the dark theme), highlight (⌘⇧H) and «Clear formatting» (⌘\): it takes bold, color, headings, lists and the rest off the selection, links stay. Shortcuts can be changed in Settings.
  • Find and replace within a note: ⌘F, ⌘G for the next match, ⌘⇧G for the previous one.
  • Spell checking: misspelled words are underlined, as in other Mac apps. Lines with calculations are not checked.
  • With the cursor on a link, its address shows under it: edit it, open the link or remove it and keep the text.
  • Dashes and quotes as you type: "--" with a space becomes "—", straight quotes become “curly” ones after English text and «guillemets» after Russian. ⌘Z right after brings back what you typed.
  • Brackets close themselves: type "(" and ")" appears too.
  • --- on its own line is drawn as a dividing line.
  • Shift+Enter in a list item starts a new line within the same item instead of a new item. Backspace at the start of that line joins it back.
  • Formatting survives copy and paste: bold, italics, headings, lists, checkboxes and links pasted from a browser, Google Docs, Word, Notes or chats stay formatted. What you copy from Note Calc arrives formatted in mail, documents and messengers, and as clean text without asterisks where there's no formatting.

Fixed

  • Text in square brackets no longer looks like a link and keeps its brackets.
  • Pasted text is no longer selected as a whole just because it mentions numbers: only a pasted column of numbers is selected (and summed right away).
  • Blank lines are kept when copying into message boxes and similar fields, where paragraphs used to run together.
  • The line above --- no longer turns into a big heading.
  • Enter on an empty list item leaves the list instead of adding a blank line. Backspace at the start of an item removes its bullet (or moves a nested item one level out).
  • Enter in the middle of a bold (italic, etc.) word keeps both halves formatted.
  • Text typed right after a bold word is bold too, as in Word and Google Docs. To go on in plain text, press ⌘B at the end of the word.
  • A numbered list renumbers itself when you delete, paste or move an item: delete the third item and the fourth becomes the third.

item.title: Note Calc 0.4.0
item.description:
Added

  • Settings → Help → «License»: Note Calc is in beta now, everything is free. There's also a field for a license key for later, and the day you joined.

Changed

  • Settings → Help → «License»: if the saved key no longer works, you can see why — expired, revoked or meant for another app. From there you can remove it, paste a new one or buy a license.
  • Note Calc now needs macOS 15 or later.

Fixed

  • Error reports now arrive from any country, including Russia: they go through my own server. You turn them on or off in Settings, as before.
  • The activation link from the email opens the Note Calc window even if it was closed, and doesn't replace a key that already works: to replace it, paste the new one in Settings → Help → License.
  • Error reports no longer contain your Mac user name or the names of notes and files.

item.title: Shotlark 0.13.0
item.description:
Added

  • Settings → About → «License»: Shotlark is in beta now, everything is free. There's also a field for a license key for later, and the day you joined.

Changed

  • Welcome tour: Screen Recording is allowed the same way as in my other apps — a row with its status and an «Allow» button; the buttons at the bottom no longer touch the edge.

Fixed

  • Error reports now arrive from any country, including Russia: they go through my own server. You turn them on or off in Settings, as before.
  • The What's New window now also appears after the first update — before, if Shotlark had been installed recently, it was skipped.
  • The update check window and the question about error reports no longer hide behind other windows — they show up in front.
  • An unknown shotlark:// link no longer shows a "Could not open the image" error — Shotlark simply skips it.
  • Error reports no longer contain the Mac user's name — neither in file paths nor in crash reports.

item.title: Cliplark 0.4.0
item.description:
Added

  • Settings → About → «License»: Cliplark is in beta now, everything is free. There's also a field for a license key for later, and the day you joined.

Fixed

  • Error reports now arrive from any country, including Russia: they go through my own server. You turn them on or off in Settings, as before.
  • The What's New window now also appears after the first update — before, if Cliplark had been installed recently, it was skipped.
  • The update check window and the question about error reports no longer hide behind other windows — they show up in front.
  • Error reports no longer contain the Mac user's name — neither in file paths nor in crash reports.

item.title: Textum 0.4.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Добавлено

  • Настройки → О программе → «Лицензия»: Textum сейчас в бете, всё бесплатно. Там же — поле для лицензионного ключа на будущее и с какого дня ты с нами.

Исправлено

  • Отчёты об ошибках теперь доходят из любой страны, включая Россию: они идут через мой сервер. Включаются и выключаются, как раньше, в настройках.
  • Окно «Что нового» теперь появляется и после первого обновления — раньше, если Textum поставили недавно, оно пропускалось.
  • Окно проверки обновлений и вопрос про отчёты об ошибках больше не прячутся за другими окнами — сразу видны впереди.
  • В отчётах об ошибках больше нет имени пользователя Mac — ни в путях к файлам, ни в отчётах о падениях.

item.title: Dictum 0.4.0
item.description:
The change history is in Russian.

Добавлено

  • Настройки → О программе → «Лицензия»: Dictum сейчас в бете, всё бесплатно. Там же — поле для лицензионного ключа на будущее и с какого дня ты с нами.
  • Плашка записи встряхивается и предупреждает, если во время диктовки курсор ушёл из поля ввода или ты перешёл в другое приложение: текст в таком случае не вставится. Вернёшь курсор — предупреждение пропадёт.
  • Настройки → О программе → «Что нового»: вся история изменений по версиям, как в меню Dictum.

Изменено

  • Новая основная модель — сжатая Whisper large-v3 turbo: 650 МБ вместо 1,6 ГБ, скачивается и готовится к работе в разы быстрее, а распознаёт так же. Если у тебя уже стоит прежняя, она останется — теперь она называется «Whisper large-v3 turbo (полная)». Сменить модель — Настройки → Модели.

Исправлено

  • Скачивание модели больше не выглядит зависшим: полоска идёт по объёму, рядом видно «0,8 из 1,6 ГБ». Если интернет пропал, Dictum так и скажет; скачивание продолжится с того же места.
  • Скачивание и подготовка модели теперь идут одной полоской в два шага: видно, что после скачивания работа продолжается и сколько уже идёт. Подготовка — только в первый раз, на некоторых Mac до 15 минут; пока можно диктовать другой моделью.
  • У полной модели Whisper large-v3 turbo теперь указан настоящий размер — 1,6 ГБ (раньше было написано 630 МБ).
  • Отчёты об ошибках теперь доходят из любой страны, включая Россию: они идут через мой сервер. Включаются и выключаются, как раньше, в настройках.
  • «Вставить последнее ещё раз», когда курсор не в поле ввода, больше не вставляет текст в никуда: он появится на плашке с кнопками «Вставить» и «Скопировать».
  • Кнопка «Вставить» на панели невставленного текста больше не закрывает панель впустую, если курсор не в поле ввода: панель подскажет поставить курсор, а повторное нажатие вставит текст всё равно.
  • Если во время диктовки убрать курсор из поля ввода, оставшись в том же приложении, текст больше не теряется: появится панель «Вставить / Скопировать», как при переходе в другое приложение.
  • Окно «Что нового» теперь появляется и после первого обновления — раньше, если Dictum поставили недавно, оно пропускалось.
  • Окно проверки обновлений и вопрос про отчёты об ошибках больше не прячутся за другими окнами — сразу видны впереди.
  • В отчётах об ошибках больше нет имени пользователя Mac — ни в путях к файлам, ни в отчётах о падениях.

  • При запуске больше не всплывает несколько окон сразу: если открылось окно разрешений, вопрос про отчёты и «Что нового» подождут следующего запуска.

item.title: Shotlark 0.12.0
item.description:
Added

To check by hand — the menu bar icon → “Check for Updates…” or Settings → About; the automatic check can be turned off there too.
